errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the chart's actual title, which is "alle Befragten mit Antwort ja (in %)" (all respondents with answer yes (in %)). This title explicitly states the purpose and content of the chart.

The description states the chart shows results of a survey on "founding barriers of young people." This information is not present in the chart image itself and appears to be taken from external context, which violates the instruction to describe only what is visually present in the figure.

The description repeatedly uses the term "Zustimmung" (agreement) to describe what the bars represent. The chart's title specifies "Antwort ja" (answer yes), which is more neutral. Using "agreement" is an interpretation of what a 'yes' answer means, rather than a direct, objective description of the label.
The description of the x-axis mentions the scale from 0 to 30 but omits the tick label interval, which is every 5 units (0, 5, 10, ...).
